title: Two Women at Pool
description: A light-skinned heavy woman wearing a crown and black swim bottoms is jumping into a pool with her mouth open and one hand raised while a dark-skinned heavy woman in a purple swimsuit stands on the edge pointing at her. The setting is a pool area at dusk with a diving board, pink flamingo float, unicorn pool toy, and palm trees in the background.
prompt: A realistic painting of two plus-size women at a pool at dusk. A pale heavy woman wearing a small crown and black swim bottoms is mid-jump into the water with mouth open and one hand raised. A dark-skinned heavy woman in a purple one-piece swimsuit stands on the pool edge pointing at her. Water has ripples, a pink flamingo float, glittery unicorn pool toy, and diving board above. Palm trees and building with sign visible in background under purple sky.
